question_text: In a route list, segment_time[k] is the time from stop k-1 to stop k, and segment_time[0]=0. Explain how to calculate journey time between two known stop indices a and b in either direction, assuming equal travel time in each direction.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Find low=min(a, b) and high=max(a, b). Add segment_time[k] for k from low+1 through high inclusive. Equal indices give an empty sum of zero.

marking_points.criterion: Uses low+1 through high inclusive; avoids preceding segment.
